name: MDS Quick Estimate
author: mds-plugins

sections.description:
Build professional quote request forms in minutes using an intuitive drag-and-drop builder. Display instant price estimates, create conditional fields, and receive detailed quote requests directly in your WordPress dashboard.

Why MDS Quick Estimate?
* Designed for artisans and small businesses.
* No coding required.
* Create beautiful quotation forms in minutes.
* Display live pricing.
* Conditional fields.
* Email notifications.
* Quote request management.
* Ready-to-use templates.
* Mobile-friendly.
* Lightweight and fast.

Who is it for?

  • Electricians
  • Plumbers
  • Landscapers
  • Painters
  • Roofers
  • Cleaning companies
  • Web agencies
  • Freelancers
  • Repair services
  • Interior designers
  • Moving companies
    etc.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mds-quick-estimate/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Quick Estimate from the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Create your first quote form.
  5. Insert the generated shortcode into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require coding skills?

No. All forms can be created using the visual builder.

Can I create conditional fields?

Yes. Fields can appear only when specific conditions are met.

Can visitors see the quote total before submitting?

Yes. The total is updated automatically while the form is being completed.

Can I receive quote requests by email?

Yes. Administrators receive a detailed email containing the customer’s selections.

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. Forms are designed to work on desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
